data.text: LORD, who may stay in your tent? Who may dwell on your holy mountain?
One who walks with integrity, does what is righteous, and speaks truth from his heart;
who does not slander with his tongue, does no harm to his neighbor, and brings no reproach upon those near him;
who despises the vile but honors those who fear the LORD; who swears to his own hurt and does not go back on his word;
who does not lend his money at interest or accept a bribe against the innocent. One who does these things will never be shaken.
